+import process from 'node:process'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { configFileGlobs, templateUsesFileHash } from '../src/config-hash.ts'
+
+test('globs are relative to each directory and never recurse', () => {
+  process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE = '/ws'
+  const globs = configFileGlobs('/ws/app/web')
+  assert.ok(globs.includes('mise.toml'))
+  assert.ok(globs.includes('app/mise.toml'))
+  assert.ok(globs.includes('app/web/.tool-versions'))
+  assert.ok(globs.includes('.config/mise/mise.lock'))
+  assert.ok(globs.every(g => !g.includes('**')))
+})
+
+test('stops at the workspace and ignores a working directory outside it', () => {
+  process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE = '/ws'
+  assert.ok(configFileGlobs('/ws').every(g => !g.startsWith('..')))
+  assert.deepEqual(configFileGlobs('/elsewhere'), [])
+})
+
+test('keeps directories whose names start with two dots', () => {
+  process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE = '/ws'
+  assert.ok(configFileGlobs('/ws/..app').includes('..app/mise.toml'))
+})
+
+test('escapes glob characters in directory names', () => {
+  process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE = '/ws'
+  assert.ok(configFileGlobs('/ws/a[1]').includes('a[[]1[]]/mise.toml'))
+})
+
+test('only template expressions that reach the file hash need it', () => {
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('k-{{file_hash}}'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('{{default}}-x'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('{{#if file_hash}}a{{/if}}'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('default-{{platform}}-file_hash'), false)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('{{this.file_hash}}'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('{{./default}}'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('{{lookup . "file_hash"}}'), true)
+  assert.equal(templateUsesFileHash('static'), false)
+})

+import * as path from 'path'
+import Handlebars from 'handlebars'
+
+// Config files mise reads from each directory, relative to that directory (see
+// DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAMES in mise). The cache key hashes these in the working
+// directory and its parents, as mise finds them, rather than walking every
+// subdirectory, which is slow once node_modules or vendor/bundle exist.
+const MISE_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS = [
+  `.config/mise/conf.d/*.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/conf.d/*/mise*.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/config.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/config.lock`,
+  `.config/mise/config.*.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/config.*.lock`,
+  `.config/mise/mise.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/mise.*.toml`,
+  `.config/mise/mise.lock`,
+  `.config/mise/mise.*.lock`,
+  `.config/mise.toml`,
+  `.config/mise.lock`,
+  `.config/mise.*.toml`,
+  `.config/mise.*.lock`,
+  `.mise/conf.d/*.toml`,
+  `.mise/conf.d/*/mise*.toml`,
+  `.mise/config.toml`,
+  `.mise/config.lock`,
+  `.mise/config.*.toml`,
+  `.mise/config.*.lock`,
+  `mise/conf.d/*.toml`,
+  `mise/conf.d/*/mise*.toml`,
+  `mise/config.toml`,
+  `mise/config.lock`,
+  `mise/config.*.toml`,
+  `mise/config.*.lock`,
+  `.mise.toml`,
+  `.mise.lock`,
+  `.mise.*.toml`,
+  `.mise.*.lock`,
+  `mise.toml`,
+  `mise.lock`,
+  `mise.*.toml`,
+  `mise.*.lock`,
+  `.tool-versions`
+]
+
+/** True when the template references `file_hash` or `default` (which embeds it). */
+export function templateUsesFileHash(template: string): boolean {
+  const walk = (node: unknown): boolean => {
+    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.some(walk)
+    if (node === null || typeof node !== 'object') return false
+    const n = node as Record<string, unknown>
+    // `parts` drops `this.` and `./`; a string literal could name it through a helper
+    const names = ['file_hash', 'default']
+    if (
+      n.type === 'PathExpression' &&
+      Array.isArray(n.parts) &&
+      n.parts.some(part => names.includes(part as string))
+    ) {
+      return true
+    }
+    if (n.type === 'StringLiteral' && names.includes(n.value as string)) {
+      return true
+    }
+    return Object.values(n).some(walk)
+  }
+  try {
+    return walk(Handlebars.parseWithoutProcessing(template))
+  } catch {
+    return true
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Globs for the config files mise would find from `cwd`: each pattern in `cwd`
+ * and every parent up to the workspace, which is all `hashFiles` can see.
+ */
+export function configFileGlobs(cwd: string): string[] {
+  const workspace = path.resolve(process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE || process.cwd())
+  const globs: string[] = []
+  for (let dir = path.resolve(cwd); ; dir = path.dirname(dir)) {
+    const rel = path.relative(workspace, dir)
+    if (
+      rel === '..' ||
+      rel.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
+      path.isAbsolute(rel)
+    ) {
+      break
+    }
+    const prefix = rel
+      ? `${rel
+          .split(path.sep)
+          .join('/')
+          .replace(/[*?[\]{}()!+@]/g, '[$&]')}/`
+      : ''
+    for (const pattern of MISE_CONFIG_FILE_PATTERNS) {
+      globs.push(prefix + pattern)
+    }
+    if (dir === workspace) break
+  }
+  return globs
+}
